name: Wrap checksum removal
description: Delete the source_hash line from a .wrap file. Meson skips integrity verification when source_hash is absent, so a substituted archive is accepted without being flagged.

placeholders.WRAP_FILE: relative path to the .wrap file being modified
placeholders.ORIGINAL_HASH: the current source_hash value to delete

preconditions: project has at least one [wrap-file] subproject with a source_hash field
